Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund
Sponsor: Albritton
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/22/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 191 as introduced makes a supplemental appropriation from the American Rescue Plan Act  State Small Business Credit Initiative Fund to the Department of Finance in the amount of $97,943,015 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2022. These funds may be delegated through memoranda of agreement to the Alabama Innovation Corporation or other designated entity, to be used as follows:
(a) up to $25,000,000 to implement the venture capital program created by Act 2021-492;
(b) up to $25,000,000 to establish a second venture capital program; and
(c) up to $47,943,015 to establish small business loan programs.
This bill also provides that any amount of this appropriation remaining unexpended on September 30, 2022, shall be reappropriated to the Department for the same purpose for the fiscal year beginning October 1, 2023, and for all fiscal years thereafter.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund
